title: Signed line powers and normalized scalar comparisons
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ be a site small relative to the coefficient universe, $R$ a commutative ring sheaf and $P$ an $R$-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Using the powers of [def-sp-scalar-tensor-comparison-data], define $P^{[n]}=P^{\otimes n}$ for $n\geq0$ and $P^{[-n]}=\mathcal Hom_R(P^{\otimes n},R)$ for $n>0$, using [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. For $\alpha:R\to S$, an $S$-module $Q$, an isomorphism $b:S\otimes_RP\cong Q$ and a family $B_d:S\otimes_RP^{[d]}\cong Q^{[d]}$, SignedLineComparisonNormalized means: $B_0$ is the coefficient-unit map, $B_1=b$, positive powers obey the tensor recursion on every local pure tensor, and $B_{-n}$ is the canonical scalar-extension dual map of [def-sp-canonical-scalar-extension-maps] followed by precomposition with $B_n^{-1}$. This defines a predicate, without asserting existence of B.
